commit d0490dbdfc5bccab598d87b6f3e4a5c748a8d19b
Author: migmac99 <migmacthegamer@gmail.com>
Date:   Thu Apr 30 20:41:15 2026 +0100

    refactor(deploy-cloudflare): security hardening, modularity, and doc pass
    
    Security:
    - Add auth guard (401) to all CF-extra routes that previously had none:
      GET /api/adapters, GET /api/plugins, GET /api/plugins/ui-contributions,
      GET /api/companies/:id/skills, GET /api/companies/:id/join-requests,
      GET /api/companies/:id/user-directory, GET /api/companies/:id/events/ws
    - WebSocket endpoint now authenticates before the 101 upgrade response
    
    Correctness:
    - route-registry: add length-mismatch guard on compiledPathCache so a
      route-count change invalidates and rebuilds the cache rather than
      silently misaligning handlers with compiled path patterns
    - cf-express-bridge/runChain: add per-slot single-use `boundNext` guard
      so a buggy middleware that calls next() twice does not advance the
      chain past the wrong handler
    
    Modularity — split cf-extra-routes.ts (~320 lines) into focused modules:
      src/worker/routes/adapters.ts        — GET /api/adapters
      src/worker/routes/plugins.ts         — GET /api/plugins + /ui-contributions
      src/worker/routes/company-access.ts  — join-requests + user-directory
      src/worker/routes/company-skills-cf.ts — skills + deriveSkillSource helper
      src/worker/routes/events.ts          — WebSocket event stream
      cf-extra-routes.ts is now a thin barrel that calls each register*() fn
    
    Documentation:
    - cf-extra-routes barrel: lists all child modules and their auth contract
    - route-registry: WHY comments for adapterRoutes (sentinel proxies) and
      accessRoutes (extractAllRoutesFromRouter vs ext)
    - cf-express-bridge: double-next() guard explained in runChain comment
    - Each new route file has a module-level JSDoc with CF-specific caveats
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
